name: narrhalla-player
description: Narrhalla Player – Android-Hülle (Capacitor) um die Web-App

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html style.css app.js manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp -r icons www/
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:www && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-icons.mjs
